codeSnippets.description: Modular separation of IPC definitions across Shared, Preload, and Main layers

considerations: Maintains strict context isolation by preventing direct Node.js API access from the Renderer.
Eliminates magic strings through shared channel constant definitions.
Pairs handler registration with unregistration to avoid IPC listener memory leaks.
keyImplementationPoints: Single source of truth for IPC channel strings and payload types under src/shared/
Modular preload modules exposed via contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld
Decoupled handler and service logic in the Main process
patterns.overview: A 3-tier architecture ensuring strict Electron security boundaries, type safety, and modularity between Main, Preload, and Renderer processes.
patterns.purpose: Provide secure, structured, and type-safe cross-process communication for desktop applications.
patterns.summary: Modular 3-Tier IPC Bridge Architecture enforcing type safety and boundary isolation in Electron applications.
patterns.title: Modular 3-Tier IPC Bridge Architecture

codeSnippets.description: IPC action wrapper intercepting 401 status and normalizing serialized errors

considerations: Debounced toast triggers prevent notification spam on bulk 401 failures.
Configurable treatUnauthorizedAsSessionExpired flag supports form login errors where 401 means invalid credentials rather than session expiry.
keyImplementationPoints: Main process encodes HTTP statuses into error messages as HTTP_STATUS_${code}::${message}
Renderer extracts HTTP status and strips internal Electron IPC method prefix strings
Centralized session invalidation and debounced toast notifications
patterns.overview: Encapsulated error normalization and session expiration interceptor bridging the Electron IPC serialization boundary.
patterns.purpose: Normalize serialized IPC errors and handle global 401 unauthorized session expiry reliably.
patterns.summary: Centralized IPC error normalization with automatic 401 session expiration interceptor and toast rate-limiting.
patterns.title: IPC Error Normalization & 401 Session Interceptor

codeSnippets.description: AES encrypted storage helper with event dispatching for cross-component sync

considerations: Symmetric encryption key is bundled client-side and protects against passive snooping, not determined local root attacks.
Automatic corruption pruning prevents runtime parsing crashes.
keyImplementationPoints: Custom window storage event dispatch for instant intra-window reactivity
Automatic cleanup of corrupted or unparseable entries
patterns.overview: A reactive React hook wrapping localStorage with transparent AES encryption, corruption resilience, and intra-window state synchronization.
patterns.purpose: Persist sensitive client data locally with reactive synchronization and encryption.
patterns.summary: Reactive client-side local storage hook with transparent AES encryption and event-driven state synchronization.
patterns.title: Client-Side Encrypted Reactive Local Storage

codeSnippets.description: Deterministic sorted key-value tree traversal for cryptographic payload signing

considerations: Relies on SHA-1 hashing, which should ideally be upgraded to HMAC-SHA256 for stricter modern compliance.
Candidate status retained due to backend contract specificity.
keyImplementationPoints: Alphabetical sorting of object keys at all nesting levels
Timestamp injection to prevent replay attacks
Outbound header injection in the Main process prior to HTTP transmission
patterns.overview: Deterministic canonicalization of outbound API request bodies combined with cryptographic hashing for tamper-proof API communication.
patterns.purpose: Verify API payload integrity and prevent request tampering between desktop client and server.
relatedKnowledge: API Request Signing and Anti-Replay Mechanisms
patterns.summary: Main-process outbound request signing using recursive key sorting and cryptographic hashing.
patterns.title: Deterministic Payload Canonicalization & Cryptographic Request Signing
